zh: 提升任务看板性能。重复送达的相同状态不再让整块看板重绘，侧栏开合动画更轻。
适配 Android 平板。切换详情高度时先移动面板，再更新看板。
en: Improve Tasks board performance. An unchanged status no longer redraws the whole board, and the sidebar animation does less work.
Adapt the Android tablet. Changing the details height moves the panel before the board updates.
